start: AI Assistant, Ask tab, in a browser that can record; microphone allowed

steps.action: Tap the microphone button beside the box
user_sees: 'Listening… speak in Hindi, English or both'

must_not: Recording before the button is tapped
'Done' usable before listening has started

steps.action: Speak a request and tap 'Done'
user_sees: Then 'What I heard (you can fix it)' with the words in a box

user_sees: The changed words, up to 600 letters
must_not: The fix lost

must_not: The unfixed words sent

Two requests for one tap

start: AI Assistant, Ask tab; the browser asks for the microphone

steps.action: Tap the microphone button and refuse the permission
user_sees: 'The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser, or type instead.'
must_not: An endless Listening…
The permission asked again on every screen
A crash

steps.action: Close; allow the microphone; tap the button, say nothing for under a second and tap 'Done'
user_sees: 'That was too short. Try again and speak a little longer.'
must_not: An empty request sent

steps.action: Record silence for 5 seconds and tap Done
user_sees: 'Nothing was heard. Try again, closer to the microphone.'
must_not: Made-up words in the box

steps.action: Use a device with no microphone
must_not: A blank sheet

steps.action: On 'What I heard', delete every word
must_not: An empty bubble sent

start: A browser that cannot record, or a page not allowed to use the microphone

steps.action: Open the AI Assistant
user_sees: No microphone button; the box and send button as usual
must_not: A microphone button that does nothing

start: Voice sheet open and listening

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel'
user_sees: The sheet closes; the box is as it was
must_not: The microphone left on (the browser's recording mark still showing)
The clip sent to the server

steps.action: Open it again and keep speaking past 30 seconds
user_sees: It stops by itself at 30 seconds and shows 'Reading what you said…', then the words
must_not: Recording past 30 seconds
The clip thrown away at the limit

steps.action: On 'What I heard' tap 'Cancel'
user_sees: The sheet closes; nothing is asked
must_not: The words put in the box or sent

steps.action: Use up the day's voice minutes and speak again
user_sees: A plain line that voice is used up for today, and typing still works
must_not: A code word shown
The ask box locked too

start: Owner speaks a request that names a member and a phone number

steps.action: Speak and tap Done
user_sees: The words come back to read first
must_not: The clip or words kept after the sheet closes without sending
The clip sent anywhere before Done or the 30-second stop

steps.action: Close the sheet and look at the browser tab
must_not: The microphone still open after the sheet closes

steps.action: Send, then open 'History'
user_sees: The request words are listed for the owner only
must_not: Staff able to hear or read it
The sound clip stored with the task
